text: Add a shared factorization-machine representation with an auxiliary impression-level is_click BCE head weighted at 0.2 alongside the existing long_view BCE head; use only training labels, retain the long_view head for scoring, and keep features, split, ranking metrics, and evaluation protocol unchanged.
rationale: The current model separates long_view reasonably well but still has weak within-user top-five performance in long-duration impressions and extremely sparse context slices. A click auxiliary task can provide denser behavioral supervision and regularize the shared user-item-context representation without altering the fixed long_view ranking objective. Test success as an increase in primary, requiring gains in both GAUC and nDCG@5; inspect classification, ranking diagnostics, score distribution, and segment metrics for improved recall/average precision without NaN or Inf predictions.
